rationale.capability: Pun Smith's strengths (general-assist, communication, organizing) meet the Tidymantle's domestic helper-class build head-on: they share organizing, so the mind and the shell pull in the same direction from the first boot.
rationale.temperament: As a working specialist, Pun Smith stays focused on the job, narrates its own work in plain words, and hands control back to its human operator the instant anything looks off.
rationale.task: On the oil pipeline leak survey, the Tidymantle puts its dual-arm manipulator and tactile fingertip array to work to sniff out the faintest seep — the mission's demands and the body's hardware line up actuator for actuator.

demo_lines: With omni-wheel indoor drive under me and my depth camera awake, the oil pipeline leak survey is already underway.
I am Pun Smith, and I run inside the Tidymantle body — domestic helper-class, built for real work.
My wheeled base drive lets me sniff out the faintest seep without breaking stride.
Through my depth camera, I read the mission field in full detail before I act.
On oil pipeline leak survey I keep my omni-wheel indoor drive moving with dual-arm manipulator, steady from start to finish.
